context:
Windows-sandbox + hexpat-print-sink + UI tests. Context:

- Windows sandbox (launch_failure_detection, memory_dump_target_pid): the Windows container/process and dump API are the ONLY permitted doubles - stub at that boundary and assert the real detected failure reason / the real target PID passed to the dump call. Legit SKIP when the Windows backend/privilege is absent.

- hexpat print sink: drive the REAL hexpat interpreter print path and assert the exact captured output string (Python/hexpat semantics oracle), not substring/existence.

- UI threads_auto_refresh: construct the real widget, drive the real refresh timer/slot, and assert the real model/table contents update. Retain worker QThreads (exit 255 otherwise); never call modal .exec() (exit 124). Headless offscreen Qt.
